title: Simple Connected Leaves
description: Adds simple connected textures to leaf blocks, compatible with other packs.
body:
This simple pack adds a solid interior to leaves that will connect to other matching leaf blocks, to create a more dense feel. Continuity or Optifine required!

![Oak tree using the pack](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/6TVRZi60/images/6b185e867d5fdcfb67266263dab58dd798416c4f_350.webp)

/!\\ _Note: This is not a performance pack! It will not magically improve your FPS_ /!\\

In fact, I would recommend using a leaf culling mod such as [Cull Leaves](https://modrinth.com/mod/cull-leaves) or [Cull Fewer Leaves](https://modrinth.com/mod/cull-fewer-leaves) alongside this pack.
